advancements.berserker_rpg.equipment.nor: Obtain the full Northling Armor Set
advancements.berserker_rpg.spell_cast_be: Use a skill from the Ancient Rune Tome
effect.berserker_rpg.blood_reckoning.des: Grants absorption for missing health. Heals for a portion of your remaining absorption when the effect runs out.
effect.berserker_rpg.blood_sacrifice.des: Converts your health to absorption hearts.
effect.berserker_rpg.outrage.description: Increases attack damage and attack speed.
effect.berserker_rpg.rage.description: Increases Rage & Attack Speed. You deal more damage, the less health you have.
Spell Book of Berserkers, using raid axe's and other high damage weapons. The Berserker is all about high physical melee damage.
- Strengths: High damage output.
- Weaknesses: Ranged Enemies
- Equipment: Light Armor
spell.berserker_rpg.apprehend.descriptio: Strikes a wide area in front of you, pulling hit enemies towards you and lowering their armor by {effect|berserker_rpg:apprehend|0||abs}.
spell.berserker_rpg.apprehend.name: Apprehend
spell.berserker_rpg.blood_reckoning.desc: Grants absorption equal to {absorption_ratio} of your missing health. When the effect ends, converts {heal_ratio} of your remaining absorption into a heal.
spell.berserker_rpg.blood_reckoning.name: Blood Reckoning
spell.berserker_rpg.bloody_strike.descri: Deals {damage} physical damage, costing {self_damage} of it back as self-damage in exchange for {effect|berserker_rpg:blood_sacrifice} absorption. Skipped entirely below half a heart.
spell.berserker_rpg.bloody_strike.name: Bloody Strike
spell.berserker_rpg.improved_bloody_stri: Increases power multiplier of Bloody Strike by {power_multiplier}
spell.berserker_rpg.northerners_guilloti: Leaps to the target, striking a lethal blow. Deals 20%% bonus damage, increasing by {damage_per_amplifier} for every level of a harmful effect on the target. Always critically strikes targets at or below {execute_threshold} of their max health.
spell.berserker_rpg.outrage.description: Clears harmful effects and increases attack damage by {effect|berserker_rpg:outrage|0|minecraft:generic.attack_damage} for {effect_duration}. If Rage is active, extends the duration by an additional {rage_bonus_duration}.
spell.berserker_rpg.outrage.name: Outrage
spell.berserker_rpg.wild_rage.descriptio: Enter a wild rage, increases rage by {effect|berserker_rpg:rage|0|more_rpg_classes:rage_modifier} and attack speed by {effect|berserker_rpg:rage|0|minecraft:generic.attack_speed}, stacking up to {effect_amplifier_cap} times.
spell.berserker_rpg.wild_rage.name: Wild Rage
